execution_contexts.scope: Observed execution path only; unexecuted branches and uninitialized holder state are not qualified

tokens.review_basis: Complete NEXST child and all inherited source paths: balanceOf is unmodified ERC20 direct mapping getter. Pause/owner/roles/blacklist/cap guard mutations, not getter. Two declared immutable cap placeholders reconstruct exact canonical runtime. RoleData declares two words, but only nested membership has reachable mutation paths. No reachable child call to internal _setRoleAdmin; genuine adminRole +1 writes are deliberately rejected. Narrow root6 mapping rule avoids generic word-width acceptance of membership_hash+1. Twelve admin overrides remain independent getter controls, never approved write keys.

getter_review.reachability: Complete NEXST child inherits ERC20.balanceOf without an override or modifier; ERC20Burnable, ERC20Capped, ERC20Pausable, Ownable and AccessControl do not override it. No external calls, additional storage, caller, timestamp or chain-context dependency on the getter path.

metadata_semantics: Root 0 is the sole getter balance mapping; root 1 is nested allowances. Supply 2 changes on mint/burn; name 3 and symbol 4 are constructor-only string heads.
Slot 5 packs paused at byte offset 0 and owner at byte offset 1 (20 bytes). Pause/unpause and ownership transfer/renounce can change it. Custom decimals is a constructor-only uint8 at slot 7.

Root 6 maps bytes32 roles to a 64-byte RoleData: membership mapping at record offset 0 and adminRole bytes32 at offset 1. Membership keys are keccak(pad(address)||keccak(role||slot6)); adminRole is keccak(role||slot6)+1. Public grant/revoke/renounce mutate membership. _setRoleAdmin is internal and has no caller in the complete child; getRoleAdmin reads the second word.

Root 8 is address=>bool blacklist; public owner-only setter changes it. Blacklist, pause, role and immutable cap affect _update/mint authorization, not balanceOf. rescueTokens has external calls only on its independent mutation path. No permit/nonces.

Candidate root6 width 2 represents the exact declared record, including nested membership via verified preimages. Existing recursive mapping/record-width support can represent it; no production extension identified by source review.
remaining_specific_gates: Independently control packed pause/owner bits, supply, decimals, allowances, blacklist and both role members; test arbitrary bytes32 role and nested address preimages, admin offset +1 and reject offset +2/unknown roots.

Although role admin setter is not reachable in this runtime, record-width configuration still requires exact override controls and rejection tests before promotion; a membership-only root6 candidate is a narrower alternative if admin-record writes remain deliberately rejected.
Pin both occurrences of immutable cap id1402. Raw values, caller/blacklisted/paused accounts and null-address getter behavior need independent controls.
